sections.section_title: Section A: Fundamental Sports & Motor Skills

questions.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct word about throwing, catching, kicking, and racket skills.

items.sentence: When catching a ball below your waist, your little fingers should touch together to form a ________ shape with your hands.
Kicking a football with the inside of your foot helps you pass the ball to your teammate with better ________.
In badminton, the lightweight feathered object that players hit across the net is called a ________.
Keeping your eyes fixed on the ball while trying to catch or strike it is an example of good hand-eye ________.
Short, quick footwork drills from 'Little Steps' help improve your body balance and ________.

questions.instruction: Choose the correct option for each question based on sports skills, ball control, and footwork drills.

items.question: Which part of your foot is safest and most effective for stopping or trapping a rolling football on the ground?
options: The sole or inside of the foot
The pointed tip of your toes
items.answer: The sole or inside of the foot

items.question: How should you hold a badminton racket when preparing to strike a shuttlecock?
options: Using only two fingers at the top of the shaft
Firmly by the handle using a comfortable handshake grip
Holding the circular net frame with both hands
Balancing the bottom of the handle on your palm
items.answer: Firmly by the handle using a comfortable handshake grip

items.question: In throwing drills, when is an overhand throw most useful?
options: When rolling the ball gently along the grass
When trying to throw the ball a long distance with power
When passing the ball to someone standing one foot away
When bouncing the ball directly between your feet
items.answer: When trying to throw the ball a long distance with power

items.question: Why do we practice agility and quick direction-change drills in 'Little Steps'?
options: To move quickly, change direction safely, and stay balanced during games
To learn how to stand still in one spot for a long time
To see who can fall over first on the playground
To avoid running while playing sports
items.answer: To move quickly, change direction safely, and stay balanced during games

items.question: When catching a high-flying ball arriving above your chest level, how should your thumbs and index fingers be positioned?
options: Pointing upwards together to form a W or triangle shape
items.answer: Pointing upwards together to form a W or triangle shape

questions.instruction: Match each traditional game or sport to its correct equipment, court setup, or key action.

pairs.answer: Seven flat stones piled in a tower and a soft ball
Chanting a single word continuously in one breath while tagging opponents
Chasing team players sit in a row facing alternate directions
Jumping on one or two feet inside numbered squares drawn on the ground

questions.instruction: Identify the odd option out in each group based on game types, rules, and equipment.

items.question: Which of the following is an indoor board game and NOT an outdoor team sport?
Identify the odd rule out that is NOT allowed during a game of Kabaddi:
options: Tagging an opponent player with your hand or foot
Kicking the ball into a goal post to score a point
Crossing the midline to enter the opponent's court
items.answer: Kicking the ball into a goal post to score a point

items.question: Which piece of equipment does NOT belong to the game of Lagori (Seven Stones)?
Identify the odd movement that is NOT part of good agility and footwork drills:
options: Standing completely still like a statue
Light hopping on the balls of your feet
items.answer: Standing completely still like a statue

sections.section_title: Section C: Yoga Sadhana & Daily Health

questions.instruction: Choose the correct option for questions on Yoga Asanas, Pranayama, posture, and healthy fitness habits.

items.question: Which yoga asana is also known as the 'Tree Pose', where you stand tall and balance on one leg?
What is the primary focus when practicing Pranayama during a yoga session?
options: Running as fast as you can around the room
Lifting heavy weights with your arms
Doing quick somersaults on the mat

items.question: Which standing yoga posture requires you to stretch your body upwards like a steady mountain?
Why is it important to warm up our body before playing sports or practicing yoga?
options: It makes us tired before the game even begins
It helps prevent injuries and prepares our muscles for movement
It allows us to skip drinking water for the rest of the day
It is only done to waste time on the field
items.answer: It helps prevent injuries and prepares our muscles for movement

items.question: In Bhujangasana (Cobra Pose), which part of your body is gently lifted upwards while lying on your stomach?

What is the common English name for 'Bhujangasana', an asana where we arch our chest upwards from the floor?
What breathing practice in yoga helps calm our mind and improves lung capacity?
How many times a day should a Class 4 student brush their teeth to maintain healthy habits?
